messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — we're seeing partial embed-ingest failures (intermittent 503s) for a subset of Segment A onboarders. Filing customer comms + RCA draft. Affected list attached in the ticket.
jamie_se: On it. Do we have numbers? % of writes failing, and any common patterns (region, model)?
maria_cs: Initial numbers from support: ~8% of write attempts failed over the last 3 hours, concentrated on eu-west-1 and some requests with payloads >5MB. Ticket ID INC-2026-0312.
leo_support: Confirmed — impacted tenants: acct-514, acct-889, acct-233. All are new onboarders with larger batch imports. Partial writes meaning some vectors accepted, some dropped.
sam_ops: Monitoring alert created by monitoring-bot: INC-2026-0312. Root cause hypothesis: autoscaling race + transient GPU pool cold-starts + a retry misconfiguration leading to client-visible 503s.
anna_product: @maria_cs for comms: customers will want clarity on data durability and whether re-ingest is needed. We should be explicit about which records were dropped and give a remediation plan.
maria_cs: Draft customer message suggestion: short status, what we're doing, expected ETA for fix, mitigation steps customers can take, offer of credits and dedicated re-ingest support + office hours. Want mobile-friendly, single-paragraph initial DM/email.
jamie_se: Tech note to include: we've deployed a fix that changes retry window and ensures warm workers are provisioned for large batch imports; rolling deploy underway. Can say "a fix was deployed; monitoring shows drop in 503s" once we confirm metrics.
leo_support: Can we surface per-tenant affected vector count? Support has partial logs; I'll add a CSV with indices that failed for each tenant by EOD. That will help tailored remediation.
maria_cs: Timeline: initial status out in 30m, follow-up with RCA draft in 4h, personalized recon/sync with impacted accounts within 24h. Can ops confirm rollback/patch safe?
sam_ops: Patch is safe; it's a config guard + improved warm pool pre-provisioning. Deployment is staged — currently at 50% of eu-west-1 capacity. Full rollout expected in ~90 minutes barring new errors.
anna_product: For the customer-facing RCA follow-up: avoid jargon, include cause (autoscale/worker cold starts + retry gap), mitigation (fix + re-ingest support), and preventing recurrence (longer warm pools, retry backoff change, improved batching guidance).
leo_support: I'll coordinate CS outreach and include per-tenant CSV. Suggest offering a one-time reindex run and 2 weeks of accelerated support for affected accounts.
maria_cs: Agreed. Draft bullet for status message: "We're investigating intermittent 503 errors affecting some new embed imports in eu-west-1. A fix has been deployed; we're validating success and will provide a full RCA within 4 hours. If you experienced partial writes, we'll proactively coordinate re-ingest and credits." Thoughts?
jamie_se: Good. Add: "No customer data exposed or deleted; failures were write-timeouts, not deletions." Very important.
leo_support: Also include contact path: reply to this thread or open a priority support ticket with "INC-2026-0312".
maria_cs: Final checks: @sam_ops confirm when monitoring shows <0.5% errors for 15m and I'll publish. @anna_product please prepare short RCA paragraph for follow-up.
sam_ops: Will update here when condition met. Current error rate down to 2.1% and trending down after patch.
monitoring-bot: Incident INC-2026-0312 update: error_rate(eu-west-1, embed_write)=2.1% at 1769544800, rolling window 15m.
leo_support: Putting outreach schedule together: initial notice (30m), tailored email + reingest plan (4h), office hours invite (24h).
maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll send the 30m status and tag impacted customers. Keep updates short and concrete.
jamie_se: If we need to run manual reindexes, engineering can queue a low-priority backfill job with tenant-scoped rate limits. Lean on me.
leo_support: Noting renewal-risk flag for acct-889 — will loop AE and include credit offer in outreach.
maria_cs: OK — closing plan: 30m status, 4h RCA + per-tenant details, 24h remediation scheduling. Thread will be our single source of truth for comms.
